Coram : ARIJIT PASAYAT*, S.H. KAPADIA
v. SOFANAAJIT SEPTEMBER 7, 2007 (DRARIJITPASAYAT ANDS.H.KAPADIA,JJ.) Code of Civil Procedure, 1908: s.24-Transfer petition-Allowed by High Court-On appeal, held: High Court to reconsider the matter. C Words and Phrases: Expression 'cause of action'-Meaning of In the present appeal, the I.I. While in civil cases, normally the expression "cause of action" is used, in criminal cases as stated in s.177 Cr.P.C., reference is to the local jurisdiction where the offence is committed. These variations in E etymological expression do not really make the position different.
Decision Date : 07-09-2007 | Case No : CIVIL APPEAL No. 4110/2007 | Disposal Nature : Disposed off | Bench : 2 Judges
